data.narrative:
Onodrim Industries is a seed-stage defense and security company that has raised €40M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 private companies and 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) operating in the same sector.

The peer-median method was the applicable triangulation approach. Analysis of three same-sector, seed/Series A stage peers—UFORCE ($1.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M)—yields a median valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B. This method anchors the primary valuation estimate given the limited data surface for other quantitative methods at this stage.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $340M to $460M, centered at $400M. This implies a post-money valuation approximately 10x the €40M raised. Key uncertainties include: revenue or ARR data for Onodrim, which would enable revenue-multiple or burn-rate based cross-checks; stage heterogeneity within the peer set (one seed, two Series A); and the representativeness of the three-company sample. A more robust analysis would benefit from expanded peer data and operational metrics specific to Onodrim's business performance and defensibility within the defense-tech subsector.
